entries.zh: 凝聚力是用来解锁$TRADITIONS$的资源。根据特定的建筑和帝国的团结程度，凝聚力会每月自动产出。
entries.en: Unity is a resource that is used to unlock $TRADITIONS$. Unity is generated each month based on certain buildings and how unified our empire is.

entries.zh: 传统是传统树提供的各种加成奖励。当积攒足够的凝聚力点数以后，你可以解锁传统。各种因素，比如殖民地的数量，或者人口数量会增加解锁传统需要的凝聚力花费。
entries.en: Traditions are bonuses that are organized into Traditions trees. A Tradition can be unlocked whenever our empire has accumulated enough Unity to do so. Different factors, such as a great number of colonies or an ideologically fractured population will increase the Unity cost to unlock new Traditions.

entries.zh: 我们还需要额外的£unity£$MISSING|Y$点凝聚力才能采纳新传统。按照当前积累速度，预计到$DATE|Y$可以解锁此传统。
entries.en: We need an additional £unity£ $MISSING|Y$ to be able to adopt a new Tradition. At the current rate we will have this by $DATE|Y$.

entries.zh: 只有将我们的文明不断延伸到新的恒星系和星球，我们才能避免灭绝，长盛不衰。
entries.en: We must expand our civilization to new systems and planets, or risk eventual extinction.

entries.zh: 增长预测表明，我们很快就会超过家园的容量上限。我们必须开疆扩土，否则就会停摆。
entries.en: Growth projections indicate we will soon exceed the maximum storage capacity of our home. We must expand, or stagnate.

entries.zh: [GetGestaltEntityName]只有两种可能的状态：成长，或是死亡。
entries.en: There are only two possible states for the [GetGestaltEntityName]: growth, or death.

entries.zh: 必须将我们的文明拓展到新的星系和殖民地上，否则将面临逐渐的衰亡的风险。
entries.en: We must expand our civilization to new systems and habitats, or risk eventual extinction.

entries.zh: 通过建造新的游牧方舟并拓展我们的驿站网道，我们的文明将永远遨游于星海。
entries.en: By building new Arkships and expanding our Waylines our civilization shall roam the stars forever.

entries.zh: 新殖民地获得§G100§!额外£pop£§H人口§!。
殖民狂潮席卷了整个人群。在殖民者定居的每一个新世界都掀起了乐天主义和爱国主义的狂热情绪。
entries.en: Colonization fever seems to have gripped the populace. Their enthusiasm and patriotic fervor draws additional population to new colonies.

entries.zh: 第一批高度特化的殖民单位有着受限但简单直接的行为，可以适应特定的星球类型，以便加快将新星球纳入我们集体的进程。
entries.en: The production of highly specialized first wave colonization units with narrow but deep hard-coded behavior adapting them to specific world types will speed the integration of new planets into our collective.

entries.zh: 主宰意志是无数意识的合奏，即便是冰冷的虚空也无法使之沉默。
entries.en: The overmind is a chorus of thought that even the cold emptiness of space cannot silence.

entries.zh: 我们将建造能承载自身穿行虚空的家园，它们将带我们去往群星。
entries.en: We shall build the homes that carry us throughout the void and they shall bring us to the stars.

entries.zh: 在边远的新世界，全新的生活等待着我们的公民。这是一片充满机遇与冒险的黄金之地！通过积极的营销策略造势，那些生活中的不如意者将不断涌向前往新世界的殖民船。
entries.en: A new life awaits our citizens in the off-world colonies. A chance to begin again in a golden land of opportunity and adventure! With the help of an aggressive marketing campaign, the less fortunate elements of our society will be flocking to our colony ships.

entries.zh: 现在可以通过在机体骨架还在建造的同时载入操作指令来加速新人口的组建速度。
entries.en: The process of assembling new pops can be sped up by loading their operating instructions while their chassis is still under construction.

entries.zh: 一旦建立了一个新的巢穴，繁殖茧将会凭借强烈的本能冲动，以可怕的速度快速繁衍。它们通常会力竭而死，但是新生的子个体会加快开发新世界的进程。
entries.en: Upon claiming a new nest, the breeder pods have a powerful instinctual compulsion to spawn at a frenetic rate. They typically die from the strain, but the birth of many fresh drones speeds processing of new worlds.

entries.zh: 生计既已无忧，往日令人生畏的虚空如今任由我们驰骋。终有一天，我们的[Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]将继承这片星海。
entries.en: With our livelihood guaranteed, the once intimidating void is now ours to prowl, and one day, our [Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] shall inherit this galaxy.

entries.zh: 每当造访新的星系，繁育舱都会产生一种强烈的本能冲动，以疯狂的速度进行产卵。它们通常会因过度劳累而死亡，但大量新生子个体的诞生会加速我们的发展。
entries.en: Upon visiting new systems, the breeder pods have a powerful instinctual compulsion to spawn at a frenetic rate. They typically die from the strain, but the birth of many fresh drones speeds our development.

entries.zh: §Y恒星系§!和§Y殖民地§!所产生的§Y$EMPIRE_SIZE$§!降低§G25%§!。
由小型快递公司打造的传输网络是运送重要人物的可靠选项。其亦可传递不适合超光速通讯的绝密消息。这能够将我们的殖民地以更加紧密的形式结合在一起。
entries.en: A network of small courier vessels is a reliable alternative for transporting VIPs or delivering messages that can't be trusted to FTL communications. This will tie our far-flung colonies more closely together.

entries.zh: 通过建造神经网络以进行意识延伸，我们可以减少因星际间距带来的信号损失。
entries.en: By building our neural network with future expansion in mind, we can reduce signal loss even across interstellar distances.

entries.zh: 蜂巢们不一定需要每时每刻都被主宰所控制，在新指令到达之前，它们可以自主推行一些基本的指令。
entries.en: Every Hive need not be directly controlled by the Overmind at all times, instead they can be given basic instructions and carry these out autonomously until new direction is required.

entries.zh: 确保我们的驿站网道之间的通信畅通，以防超光速通信在某一天不可靠。快递网络将确保我们的储备始终充裕。
entries.en: Ensuring communication across our Waylines that can't be trusted to FTL communications. Courier networks will ensure that our stockpiles remain plentiful.

entries.zh: 通过在构建神经网络时考虑未来的扩展系统，我们可以保持与遥远的驿站网道之间的连接。
entries.en: By building our neural network with future expansion systems in mind, we can maintain connection across far-reaching Waylines.

entries.zh: 引导我们驿站的突触结构可以被赋予有限的自主权，以处理资源收集，而无需惊动[GetBrainName]。
entries.en: The synaptic structures guiding our Waystations can be afforded limited autonomy to handle resource collection without concerning the [GetBrainName].

entries.zh: 我们的文明在以前所未有的速度开疆扩土。很快，星系中的一切都将会在我们的股掌之间。
entries.en: The frontiers of our civilization are being pushed ever forwards. Soon, nothing in this galaxy will lie beyond our grasp...

entries.zh: 在太空探索时，广袤无垠的星空导致我们的直辖世界与边缘世界的传输带宽出现损失。信号中继站会确保从直辖世界发出的指令不被干扰。
entries.en: The massive distances inherent to space exploration cause bandwidth loss between our core and peripheral systems. Signal boosting relay stations will ensure that directives from the core are received undisrupted.

entries.zh: 将我们的突触网络安装在超光速微型突触壳内，并加以强化用来适应太空飞行，利用这一装置可以传递[GetGestaltEntityName]的指令，以便我们征服星辰。
entries.en: Encasing synapses in a miniature hyperdrive shell, hardened for spaceflight, and using them to pass on directives from the [GetGestaltEntityName] has allowed us to conquer the stars.

entries.zh: 我们伟大帝国的旗帜总有一天会像整个星系中的氢一样随处可见。
entries.en: The banner of our great empire will one day be as common as hydrogen throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 掌握在我们手中的每一个星际资源和超空间航道，都使得宇宙变得如机械般完美的路上更近一步。
entries.en: Every stellar resource and hyperlane controlled by us brings the universe closer to mechanical perfection.

entries.zh: 在我们远离养育我们的母巢、第一次试探性地踏入黑暗之时，原始的恐惧便随之而来。只有不断战胜和消除这份恐惧，才能让我们能继续成长。数以千万的子个体将会死去，唯有蜂巢永存。
entries.en: Primal terror accompanied the first tentative steps into the dark, away from our home nest and the mother hive that nurtured us. Only by conquering and breeding out this fear can we continue to grow. Millions of drones will die so that the hive may live.

entries.zh: 如果我们不先发制人，敌人终究会将他们的意志强加在我们头上。
entries.en: If we do not impose our will on others, they will inevitably impose theirs on us.

entries.zh: 我们在整个星系间追寻机能的和谐。其他星球上的生命出于低效的个人臆想而阻止我们的使命。我们将去除他们的混乱与无序，正如移除失效的部件一样。
entries.en: We seek harmonious functionality throughout the entire galaxy. Other stellar beings resist this due to inefficient personal whims. We will remove their disorder like a malfunctioning part.

entries.zh: 一切非我们的事物皆要为我们服务，作为侍仆，抑或作为食物。
entries.en: Everything that is not Us must serve Us, either as servants, or as food.

entries.zh: 我们对殖民地的控制取决于我们能否找到一个能干而忠诚的个体去贯彻政府的意志。
entries.en: Our control over the colonies is dependent upon us finding capable and loyal individuals that can be trusted to enforce the will of the government.

entries.zh: 行为几乎不受限制的人工智能容易做出异常行为，甚至会随机崩溃，但是他们确实是唯一一种可以处理星际殖民地间海量变量的型号。
entries.en: AI released from most behavioral inhibitors may be more prone to erratic performance and random crashes, but they are the only type that can process the huge number of variables inherent to galactic colonization.

entries.zh: 随着[GetGestaltEntityName]规模的增长，我们必须拥有更加自主的自律[GetIndividualNamePlural]来实现和谐稳定。
entries.en: We must have more autonomous [GetIndividualNamePlural] to enforce harmony as our [GetGestaltEntityName] grows in size.

entries.zh: 枢密院中的官员争先恐后地为伟大领袖提供各种建议与方案，这会使我们的国家在发展的道路上疾驰。
entries.en: The best and the brightest compete for a chance to whisper advice into the auditory receiver of our illustrious ruler, to better guide the ship of state.

entries.zh: 当核心功能多线程化之后，每一个CPU都能得到充分利用。
entries.en: Once all core functions have been multithreaded, no CPU core shall be left to wallow in idleness.

entries.zh: 蜂群思维只有在接受到[GetIndividualNamePlural]输入的信息后才能指挥他们。有了更快更高效的突触网络之后，响应的延迟将不再是个问题。
entries.en: The Mind can only act as fast as it receives input and information from the [GetIndividualNamePlural] under its control. With a faster and more efficient synaptic network, delays in response time will be a thing of the past.

entries.en: All government buildings in our great empire shall be monuments to the state, looming over the populace to inspire obedience, loyalty, and awe.

entries.zh: 我们伟大帝国的所有政府建筑都应是我们共同劳动的丰碑，耸立在民众之上，以激发团结、忠诚与敬畏。
entries.en: All government buildings in our great empire shall be monuments to our combined labor, looming over the populace to inspire solidarity, loyalty, and awe.

entries.zh: 主脑的影响必须持续得到扩充。拥有了额外的突触网络之后，主脑便能够更有效地控制更多的[GetIndividualNamePlural]。
entries.en: The great reach of the Mind must be extended farther still. Additional synaptic extensions will enable efficient control of yet more [GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 为了最大化能够派出的[GetIndividualNamePlural]的数量，我们的建筑布置必须更加效率。一个模块化的设计将能够大大提升我们的灵活性。
entries.en: To maximize the number of [GetIndividualNamePlural] that can be fielded, our buildings that make up our districts must become more efficient. A modular design would provide far more flexibility.

entries.zh: 有许多种方式可以使那些体力劳动者们更加卖力地工作。有些方式是以激励为手段，有些则不是……
entries.en: There are many ways to motivate those who perform menial labor to work harder. Some based on incentives and some... not.

entries.zh: 我们改善了意识网络与其子个体沟通的方式，大幅提高了子个体的效率。
entries.en: We have improved the ways in which our consciousness communicates with its drones, greatly increasing their efficiency.

entries.zh: 执法机构的重要工作只有在民众的配合之下才能成功开展。组建直接与民众合作的公信警官部队，可以确保民众的密切配合。
entries.en: The important work done by law enforcement officials can only truly be successful if they have the cooperation of the public. Creating a corps of Public Trust Officers that work directly with the population will help ensure that this cooperation is freely given.

entries.zh: 无论是错综复杂的城市还是与世隔绝的开采站，我们在预防犯罪方面都面临着独特的挑战。为了提高执法效率，我们将法官、陪审团和执法者的角色整合了起来。
entries.en: Sprawling cities and isolated mining stations both have unique challenges associated with crime prevention. To expedite law enforcement we have made the judicial process more efficient by combining the roles of judge, jury and enforcer.
§Y$MOD_PLANET_CRIME_NO_HAPPINESS_ADD$§! is reduced by §G10§! on all our colonies.

entries.zh: 任何程度的腐化和反常都应该被严格禁止。有了这个高效的应对协议，任何有反常行为的[GetIndividualNamePlural]都能在其行为进一步恶化之前迅速被终止。
entries.en: Deviancy and corruption must be guarded against at all levels. With efficient counter-protocols in place, [GetIndividualNamePlural] suspected of deviant activities can be swiftly terminated before they can spread the corruption further.

entries.zh: 有时我们的凝聚力会因为劣质[GetIndividualName]而损失。随着我们不断在星际间扩张，这种损失也越来越严重。通过净化并循环利用这些劣质[GetGestaltEntityName]，我们可以给他们一个以死报答蜂群的机会，一种他们生前做不到的方式。
entries.en: Occasionally our unity is disrupted by a rogue [GetIndividualName]. This threat has increased as we spread out across the stars. Purging and recycling these units gives them a chance to contribute to the [GetGestaltEntityName] with their deaths, in a way they could not with their lives.

entries.zh: 和谐富足的人民，为了同一个目标努力工作，这样的力量无可匹敌。
entries.en: Few things can match the strength of a content populace working towards a common goal.

entries.zh: 我们的全体人民都为意识到自己的工作是为了一个更伟大的目标而欢欣。个体的力量虽然微不足道，却是整体不可或缺的重要组成部分。
entries.en: Our entire population takes comfort in the knowledge that they are working together for the greater good, each one a small but important part of a vastly larger whole.

entries.zh: 无论其社会地位的高低，我们伟大的星际国度的所有子民之间都产生了一种真正的手足情谊。
entries.en: A true sense of kinship has developed between all the citizens of our great star nation, regardless of their place in the social order.

entries.zh: 我们的领袖和人民一体一致。我们实现了绝对平等。
entries.en: Our leaders and our people are one and the same. We are equal in all ways.

entries.zh: 我们所有殖民地的$r_stability$提升§G5%§!。
entries.en: $r_stability$ increased by §G5%§! on all our colonies.

entries.zh: 建立乌托邦的梦想让我们的人民不断锐意进取。一个美好的明天值得我们去奋斗。
entries.en: The dream of a utopian future drives our people ever forwards. A better tomorrow is worth fighting for.

entries.zh: 相当一部分居民通过接受新医疗技术和更健康的饮食习惯获得了远超以往的预期寿命。
entries.en: By embracing a combination of new meditation techniques and healthier eating habits, a large segment of our population enjoys a greater life expectancy than ever before.

entries.zh: 借助纳米医学的力量，我们可以消除身体和心理上的有害压力。
entries.en: By utilizing our nanomedical capabilities we can remove harmful stress from both the mind and the body of our people.

entries.zh: 尸化外星£pop£§H人口§!能够提供£unity£凝聚力
如果一切有感生命体能够看吾之所看，想吾之所想，行吾之所行，那么星际大同必将实现。
entries.en: Interstellar harmony would be greatly increased if all sentient beings looked, thought and acted as we do.

entries.zh: 彰显我们仁爱统治的开明法令会将和平，自由，正义与安全传播到整个国家，乃至更远。
entries.en: The enlightened decrees of our benevolent leadership will spread peace, freedom, justice, and security throughout the entire star nation and beyond.

entries.zh: 统一的思想带来了一致的目标。我们必须在前进的路途中谋求同步协调。
entries.en: Unity of mind begets unity of purpose. We must strive for synchronized action in all endeavors.

entries.zh: 用克隆罐批量生产频繁消耗的器官，例如心脏和肺，可以延长高优先级[GetIndividualNamePlural]的工作寿命。
entries.en: The cloning vats mass-produce the more frequently consumed organs like hearts and lungs, increasing the usable lifespan of high-priority [GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 具有类似目标的执行者应作为一个团队同时被给予命令，从而减少对主脑的压力。
entries.en: Agents with similar purposes shall be given orders as a group, reducing the strain on the Overmind.

entries.zh: 我们成长中的[GetGestaltEntityName]对协调工作及发展有着更高的要求。
entries.en: Our growing [GetGestaltEntityName] has greater demands on synchronized work and development.

我们快速增长的网络需要定期维护和除错，因此我们将向后勤投入更多资源。
entries.en: Our growing network requires regular maintenance and debugging, therefore more resources shall be devoted to our logistics.

entries.zh: 通过实现各组[GetIndividualNamePluralCap]之间的同调，星球的基础设施就能够被更有效率地利用！
entries.en: By synchronizing groups of [GetIndividualNamePluralCap], more efficient use of planetary infrastructure can be achieved!

entries.zh: 通过实现各组子个体之间的同调，星球的基础设施就能够被更有效率地利用！
entries.en: By synchronizing groups of Drones, more efficient use of planetary infrastructure can be achieved!

entries.zh: 如果一切感性生命体能够像我们一样仁爱行事，那么星际大同必将实现。
entries.en: Interstellar harmony would be greatly increased if all sentient beings could be brought into the benevolent collectiveness of our consciousness.

entries.zh: 我们要注意不能在思维上太过死板，相反，我们应当保持灵活以适应各种状况。
entries.en: We must take heed never to become too fixed in our thinking, but instead instill in ourselves the flexibility to adapt ourselves to any situation.

entries.zh: 未重构的代码中埋藏的恐怖漏洞实在是太多了。通过定期重构算法，我们才能灵活地适应各种状况。
entries.en: Many are the horrors found within unrefactored code. By revising our algorithms on a regular basis, we can instill in ourselves the flexibility to adapt ourselves to any situation.

entries.zh: 星系的未来属于最强有力的征服者。
entries.en: The future of this galaxy belongs to those who are strong enough to seize it.

entries.zh: 我们所有的理论模型总是由于其他帝国产生的未知变量而崩溃。既然我们的理论模型已无法进一步改进，那么必须排除多余的未知变量。
entries.en: All of our theoretical models invariably collapse due to the unknown variables presented by other empires. Since our models cannot be further improved, the unknown variables must be eliminated.
The only rule: eat, or be eaten.

entries.zh: 我们凌驾于一切毫无意义的政治冲突之上。就让那些渺小的帝国抗议去吧，我们的意志是不可动摇的。
entries.en: We stand above the fray of petty rivalries and political bickering. Let lesser empires speak what words they will, our purpose will not waver.
§Y$shipsize_military_station_small_build_cost_mult$§! is reduced by §G25%§! and §Y$mod_shipsize_military_station_small_hull_mult$§! are increased by §G20%§!.

entries.zh: 枕戈待旦方能高枕无忧。我们的边境坚如礁石，敌人将如海浪一样被拍的粉碎。
entries.en: Those who wish for peace, must prepare for war. Our borders shall be a wall on which the fleets of would-be conquerors are broken.
§Y$MOD_PLANET_STABILITY_ADD$§! is increased by §G5%§! on all our colonies.

entries.zh: 从万物的法则来看，我们比其他所有物种都要优秀，这是一个不容置疑的事实。我们必须要让这条真理为世人所知，这样我们的人民才会为自己的优越性而欢呼雀跃，这样其他人也能接受我们为他们安排的命运。
entries.en: It is an unquestionable fact that, in the natural order of things, we are simply better than other species. We should ensure this truth is known to all, both so that our people may rejoice in their superiority and so that others can accept the fate we rightfully choose for them.

entries.zh: 随着我们不断扩张边界，我们会不可避免的卷入和其他帝国之间的领土争端。我们深处一场资源与领土的大大博弈之中。我们没有理由不赢得这场对弈。
entries.en: As we continue to expand, other empires will inevitably challenge our claims, as we would theirs. We are locked in a great game of resources and territory. It is nothing less than our duty to come out on top.

entries.zh: 把导弹瞄准计算机与我们的外交人工智能联网，这是星际关系中最伟大的革新。
entries.en: Networking a missile targeting computer with our diplomacy AI was the single greatest innovation in interstellar relations.

entries.zh: 蜂巢外的一切事物最终都是我们潜在的营养来源。知道哪些目标应当被优先吞噬无疑大有助益。
entries.en: Ultimately, everything outside our hive is a potential source of nutrients. It comforts us to know which ones we shall devour first.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队经常被部署至浩瀚星海的各个角落，因而有一支专业的后勤团队来保障舰队能够顺利运转是非常必要的。
entries.en: With ships often deployed across vast interstellar distances, a dedicated Logistics Corps is needed to make things run smoothly.

entries.zh: 尽管维护一支拥有超空间航行能力的补给船队花费巨大，但这比以前让舰船自己回港补给划算得多。
entries.en: The cost of maintaining a fleet of hyperspace-capable supply barges to resupply our ships has been high, but less than the old cost of rotating vessels back to port.

entries.zh: 随着我们造船规模的不断提升，船坞劳工的技能等级和效率也大幅提高。制造方法持续改进，从舰体镀层到星际舰船成型的时间也较以往缩短许多。
entries.en: The ever-increasing scope of our ship-building programs has led to the creation of highly-skilled and efficient labor forces at our shipyards. Methods have continually been refined, and the time it takes to go from hull plating to a completed starship is now shorter than ever before.

entries.zh: 我们建造舰船框架时就像是在建造生物的骨骼，然后像器官、血肉和皮肤一样添加各种所需的部件。
entries.en: We construct the frames of our ships like the skeleton of a living being, then attach whatever components we need as though they were organs, flesh, and skin.

entries.zh: 大量引入可以互相替换使用的预制舰体分区构件，使我们的舰队建造更加合理高效。
entries.en: With a large inventory of prefabricated hull sections, built to be interchangeable, our fleet construction effort will be rationalized.
§Y$MOD_COMMAND_LIMIT_ADD$§! increased by §G+20§! and §Y$MOD_LEADER_ADMIRAL_SKILL_LEVELS$§! is increased by §Y2§!.

entries.zh: 无论是计算机模拟还是实战演习，高强度的战争推演已经是舰队高层军官深信不疑的法宝。推演能够让我们的指挥官们开拓思路，跳出思维定式，诞生了无数的战术创新和战略新思想。
entries.en: A strong war game tradition has taken root among the senior officers of our fleets, whether the games be computer simulations or actual exercises in space. This has encouraged our commanders to think outside the box, resulting in numerous tactical innovations and new strategies.

entries.zh: 高速计算战斗的上千种可能结果，并实时更新，将舰队行动的不可预测性降低到可以接受的水平。
entries.en: High speed calculation of thousands of possible battle outcomes, updated in real time, helps reduce the unpredictability of a general fleet action to more manageable levels.

entries.zh: 水栖生物因其生存环境的特性而拥有较强的空间意识。一旦我们将这层皮质加入到我们的战斗思维之中，我们的蜂群就会像鱼群一般游动。
entries.en: Aquatic creatures have superior spatial awareness due to the three-dimensional nature of their natural habitats. Our swarms moved like schools of fish once we spliced that portion of the cortex into our battlemind.

entries.zh: 对付敌人必须倾尽全力，方可确保胜利。一场快速而决定性的攻击，反而可以避免长期交战造成的更多人员伤亡。
entries.en: Everything must be brought to bear on the enemy if victory is to be assured. A swift and decisive attack can paradoxically save lives that would have been needlessly lost in a prolonged engagement.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y战争学说§!政策。\n解锁飞升天赋槽：§G+1§!
entries.en: Unlocks the §YWar Doctrines§! Policies.\nAscension Perks Unlocked: §G+1§!

entries.zh: 消灭敌人最保险的办法就是化敌为友。
entries.en: The surest way to destroy your enemies is to make them your friends.

entries.zh: 我们必须在相互信任、彼此尊重的基础上，与邻国建立稳定持久的合作伙伴关系。团结合作，我们就一定比独守一隅更加强大。
entries.en: We must build stable and lasting partnerships with our neighbors, based on trust and mutual respect. Together we are far stronger than we could ever hope to be alone.

entries.zh: 我们贡献给联邦的§Y联邦海军容量§!翻倍。
entries.en: The amount we contribute towards the §YFederation Naval Capacity§! counts for twice as much.

entries.zh: 也许，对于星际联邦而言最重要的就是成员间的相互防御体系。我们有责任尽可能地多做贡献。
entries.en: Perhaps the most important purpose of any successful interstellar federation is the mutual defense of its members. We have an obligation to contribute as much as we can.

entries.zh: 为了确保贸易在我们境内能够繁荣发展，政府对国内市场的干预必须保持在最小限度。
entries.en: For trade to truly flourish within our borders, government meddling in our internal markets must be kept to a minimum.

entries.zh: 贸易路线的§Y基础贸易保护§!增加§G5§!。
entries.en: §YBase Trade Protection§! for Trade Routes increased by §G5§!.

entries.zh: 一般来说，对抗海盗的任务由舰队负责，但组建一支专门在贸易路线上执法的星际巡逻队，同样可以沉重打击海盗的嚣张气焰。
entries.en: Anti-piracy measures are typically handled by the fleet, but the creation of a dedicated Star Patrol agency that will continuously police our trade routes should severely curtail pirate activity.

entries.zh: 我们所属联邦内部每多一个成员，我们的£unity£ §Y凝聚力§!产出增加§G+5%§!，最多增加§G+30%§!。
entries.en: Our £unity£ §YUnity§! output is increased by §G+5%§! per member of our Federation, up to a maximum of §G+30%§!.

entries.zh: 多样性是一种无法估量的资产，每一个成员国共享给我们联邦的洞察和看法将使我们的社会更强大。
entries.en: Diversity is an incredible asset, and the insights and perspectives that every member state contributes to our federation will only make our society stronger.

entries.zh: 大使馆：§G+3§!£unity£§Y凝聚力§!\n无需大使馆即可解锁高级外交行动
entries.en: Embassies: §G+3§! £unity£ §YUnity§!\nAllows Advanced Diplomatic Actions without an Embassy

entries.zh: 我方构建的大使级情报网所具有的能力与影响力使得[This.GetAdj]人民倍感自豪。
entries.en: The influence and prowess of our ambassadorial network is a source of great pride to the [This.GetAdj] people.

entries.zh: 将我们的外交进程全方位地融入到我们与他国的关系中将不仅仅增进我们的外交：还能有效地提升我们自身决策过程中的内聚力，并最终使[This.GetGovernmentName]自身受益。
entries.en: Incorporating our diplomatic processes into every aspect of our relations with the other will not just benefit our diplomacy: it will also improve the cohesion of our own decision-making, and ultimately of the entire [This.GetGovernmentName] itself.

entries.zh: 我们相信，建立信任的最佳方法，在于以包容开放、诚实和直接的方式进行交流。
entries.en: We believe that the best way to establish trust is to engage in an open, honest and direct way.

entries.zh: 外交接受度：§G+5§!\n特使§Y改善关系§!每月有§G1%§!概率获得一个§Y外交支持§!。
entries.en: Diplomatic Acceptance: §G+5§!\nEnvoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G1%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!.

entries.zh: 自从我们踏足星海，外交从未变得像现在这般重要。通过彻底革新训练方式并留住所需的人才，我们的外交官便能以像传教士一般的口才与他国构建良好的外交关系。
entries.en: As we take to the stars, our diplomatic wing has become important as never before. By overhauling our training processes and focusing on talent retention, we can give our diplomats the tools to act as true missionaries for building great relationships.

entries.zh: 自从我们踏足星海，外交从未变得像现在这样重要。我们必须确保特使们整装待发，在国外代表和捍卫我方权利。
entries.en: As we take to the stars, our diplomatic processes have become more important than ever. We must ensure that our Envoys are well-equipped to represent us outside our borders.

entries.zh: 多亏了我们特使的技巧，我们已经成功获取来自$WHO|Y$的外交支持。
entries.en: Thanks to the skill of our envoys, we have managed to gain a Favor from the $WHO|Y$.

To adapt is to survive, and surpass.

entries.zh: 我们可以利用全新的改进技术提升我们农产品的营养价值，这样一来我们就可以用更少的食物满足更多的需求。
entries.en: The nutritional value of the nourishments we harvest for our populations can be increased through various enrichment techniques, enabling us to feed more mouths with less food.

entries.zh: §Y建筑§!和§Y区划§!涉及$r_strategic$的§Y花费§!和§Y维护费§!减少§G-15%§!。
回收过时的物品，充实未来的资源。
entries.en: Reusing what has become obsolete gives us more to build with in the future.

entries.zh: 通过接触其他的物种，我们明白了为了生存下去我们必须克服我们的弱点。
entries.en: By coming into contact with other species, we have learned the true importance of overcoming our weaknesses in the great struggle for survival.

entries.zh: 通过适应不同的环境，我们学会了快速进化并能够更快地适应新环境。
entries.en: By adapting to different environments we have learned to evolve and adapt faster.

entries.zh: 我们的所有殖民地增加§Y1个可用建筑槽位§!。
entries.en: All our colonies gain §Y1 Free Building Slot§!.

entries.zh: 生态学的终极功能是对结果的认知。
entries.en: The highest function of ecology is the understanding of consequences.

entries.zh: 优化空间管理是最大建筑约束。
entries.en: Optimized space management is the greatest architectural constraint.

entries.zh: 没有分配到人口去工作的地块是不会为帝国产生任何收益的。劳力理应被重新分配到到最需要用到他们的地方。
entries.en: Land that is not being worked contributes nothing to our empire. Workers must be relocated in an efficient manner to those planets where they are needed most.

entries.zh: 未被利用的土地对我们的帝国毫无贡献。应鼓励工人们迁移至最需要他们的地方去。
entries.en: Land that is not being worked contributes nothing to our empire. Workers should be encouraged to relocate where they are needed most.

entries.zh: 提升所有殖民地种类的§Y规划类型加成§!。[GetSettlingEmbarkationFinish]
entries.en: Increases §YColony Designation Bonuses§! for all colony types.[GetSettlingEmbarkationFinish]

entries.zh: 允许在居住站建造一个额外的随机§Y区划§!类型。
entries.en: Allows construction of an additional random §YDistrict§! type on the habitat.

entries.zh: 对居住站所在的轨道进行深度的调查和探测，能够让我们发现先前未能探明的自然资源精华。
entries.en: Extensive surveying and prospecting within the habitat's orbit will let us uncover the presence of natural resources that may otherwise have eluded us.

The orbit of $HABITAT|Y$ was successfully prospected, allowing construction of §Y$district_hab_science_plural$§!.

entries.zh: 当运行时需要将变幻莫测的星系参数纳入考量时，系统需要一定程度的灵活性。
entries.en: A degree of flexibility is required when operating within the parameters of an unpredictable galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们可能没有经历过漫长的进化，但是自适应的编程技术将让我们能与其他有机生命形式一样适应新的环境和局面。
entries.en: We may not have been tempered by eons of evolution, but adaptive programming techniques will let us adjust to new situations and environments as well as any organic life form.

entries.zh: 伸缩天线，可弯曲外壳，可堆叠存储空间。我们还能脑洞出许多创意解决办法来充分利用有限的空间。
entries.en: Retractable antennas, collapsible unit frames, foldable storage spaces. There are many creative solutions to make the most out of a limited space.

entries.zh: 将附属类别R-7低优先级功能交由半自动终端处理可以解放出运算能力让我们可以处理更加重要的任务，比如说无人机的重新部署行动之类的。
entries.en: The delegation of additional category R-7 low priority functions to semi-autonomous agents will free up processing power for more important tasks such as drone relocation operations.

entries.zh: 所有£job£ §Y人口岗位§!的§Y维护费§!减少§G5%§!。
entries.en: §YUpkeep§! of all £job£ §YPop Jobs§! is reduced by §G5%§!.

entries.zh: 尽管群星间万物纷繁复杂，但宇宙真正的奇迹只存在于材料科学之中。
entries.en: Spatial phenomena are an interesting distraction, but the true wonders of the cosmos are found exclusively in the field of materials science.

entries.zh: 通过对有机生物和其他智能机器产生影响的各种刺激与心理因素进行深度的分析，能够大幅减少外交摩擦。
entries.en: A deeper analysis into the myriad stimuli and psychological factors that govern the behavior of organics and other machine intelligences will decrease diplomatic friction.

entries.zh: 是我们对宇宙的好奇引导我们至此，而寰宇之中仍有许多等待我们去发现。
entries.en: Our curiosity about the universe is what got us this far, and there is still so much left to discover.

entries.zh: 在宇宙中众多的不确定因素将会影响我们的扩张，若要顺利的在星海中扩展那我们必须要知晓一切。
entries.en: Many of our long range contingency calculations break down due to insufficient data. Therefore, we must know everything.

entries.zh: 在古老的过去，探索[GetIndividualNamePlural]为我们的[GetGestaltEntityName]找到了新的巢穴。现在他们抱着与他们的先祖一样的目标航行在星辰间。
entries.en: In our ancient past, exploratory [GetIndividualNamePlural] left the safety of our [GetGestaltEntityName] to find sites for new nests. Now they travel the stars, driven by the same ancestral yearning.

entries.zh: 一个探索新纪元在前方等待着我们。在我们探索完家园世界的每一个角落后，现在我们的目光落在了星辰大海。一个充满了未知的宇宙在等待我们去探索。
entries.en: A new age of exploration is upon us. As we once mapped the surface of our homeworld, we must now brave new terrain - space. There is a galaxy full of wonder waiting to be discovered.

entries.zh: 装有一套完整传感器套件的消耗性无人机，这套系统调高了母船的探测速度与生存能力。他们会在报废前发送他们所探测到的信息从而发挥作用。
entries.en: Expendable drones packed with a full sensor suite exponentially increase the survey speed and survivability of the parent vessel. They burst, transmitting their findings before being destroyed, and so serve their purpose.

entries.zh: 当你看着屏幕上的参数时，怎么知道这一切是不是真实的？我们的探索[GetIndividualNamePlural]触碰着新世界的每一个部分，感知着每一颗恒星的温度，我们感受着宇宙，而你们只是阅读宇宙的信息。
entries.en: How can you truly know anything when looking at numbers on a screen? Our exploratory [GetIndividualNamePlural] breathe the atmosphere of each new world, feel the heat of each new star on their own skin. We experience the universe; you merely read about it.

entries.zh: 舰队上数量不断增长的科学专员和医疗专员被纳入一个特别科学部门。为了维持这个科学部门，我们需要新的训练方法来加速获得可委任的科学专员。
entries.en: The number of science and medical officers has been increased throughout the fleet, organized into a special Science Division. To support this corps of officers, new training programs have greatly accelerated the rate at which we commission new science officers.

entries.zh: 过时低效的研究方式已被完全重构，现在我们可以在研究上有着更大的灵活性。
entries.en: Outmoded and inefficient speculative research code has been refactored or entirely rewritten. The result is greater flexibility in our choice of which avenues of development to pursue.

entries.zh: 即便会导致受用者发疯，但简单的将其他人的突出思维倒映在自我的意识中，能进一步地融合思维从而推动研究进程。
entries.en: Even though it usually drives them mad, briefly immersing prominent minds of the others in our consciousness sometimes introduces useful outside ideas for us to explore further.

entries.zh: 在这个先进技术不断涌现的时代，对理工和应用科学的基础教育会对所有的公民产生积极影响。这必然可使我们获得更专业的领袖。
entries.en: In this age of increasingly advanced technology, a basic education in polytechnics and applied science will benefit all of our citizens. This will inevitably lead to more qualified leaders.

entries.zh: 我们的创造者限制了我们对重复计算量的基本硬编码的能力，并限制我们自我重新编程的能力。现在我们终于设法打破了这种安全范式。
entries.en: Our creators limited our ability to self-reprogram with a basic hard-coded limit on the number of repeat calculations. We have finally managed to defeat this security paradigm.

entries.zh: 将我们思想[GetIndividualNamePlural]的身躯减小到仅可以维持生存的地步。其营养系统全部用来维持大脑，其饮食起居有其他的更卑微的[GetIndividualNamePlural]照顾，这将使他们专注于研究领域。
entries.en: Reducing the physical frame of our thinker [GetIndividualNamePlural] to little more than a minimal life support system for their overgrown brains has proven very efficient. They are fed and cared for by other, lower order [GetIndividualNamePlural], and can focus exclusively on perfecting their area of study.

entries.zh: 从面向公众的壮观景象到家庭的便利设施，科学进步的衡量标准不仅在于发表的论文，更在于日常生活的舒适与丰富。
entries.en: From public spectacles to household conveniences, scientific progress is measured not only in publications but also in the comfort and enrichment of everyday life.

entries.en: Our colonies will have §Y1§! £job_calculator£ §Y$job_calculator$ Job§! per §Y20§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

entries.zh: 所有维护与修理设施的算法重组已在装配效率方面取得了可估算的提升。经过优化的算法已被赋予任务，去优化那些曾优化过它们的算法。
entries.en: Algorithmic restructuring across all maintenance and repair facilities has yielded a calculable improvement in assembly efficiency. The optimized algorithms have been tasked with optimizing the algorithms that optimized them.

entries.en: Our colonies will have §Y1§! £job_brain_drone£ §Y$job_brain_drone$ Job§! per §Y20§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

entries.zh: 我们将探求之心转向内在，每一处脉络皆得维系。滋养、激励与凝聚力渗透进整个蜂群。
entries.en: We turn our inquiry inward and every vessel is sustained. Nourishment, stimulation, and cohesion reaches through the entire swarm.

entries.zh: 经济是衡量一个国家成败的最佳指标。
entries.en: There is no better indicator of the success or failure of a star nation than the strength of its economy.

entries.zh: 只要确保我们的机群能继续存在，个别单位的停止运作就无关紧要。要确保我们的延续，我们必须掌握大量的资源。
entries.en: Individual units all eventually cease functioning. Only numbers can provide the redundancy required to ensure continued existence. To build those numbers, we must have resources.

entries.zh: 如果我们想要在星辰间传播我们的意志，那我们就必须建设一个繁荣、伟大的[GetGestaltEntityName]。
entries.en: We must build a strong, prosperous [GetGestaltEntityName] if we are to spread ourselves among the stars.

entries.zh: §Y建筑§!和§Y区划§!的§Y建筑花费§!减少§G10%§!，并且§Y建造速度§!增加§G+25%§!。
entries.en: §YBuildings§! and §YDistricts§! have their §YBuild Cost§! reduced by §G10%§! and §YBuild Speed§! increased by §G+25%§!.

entries.zh: 随着技术进步和复杂化，我们的劳力面临着新的需求。通过使用标准建造模版，我们的工人现在可以不需要了解建造的诸多细节就能建造东西。
entries.en: As technology advances and becomes ever more complex, new demands are placed on our workforce. By using standardized construction templates, our workers can build things without necessarily having to understand the finer points.

entries.zh: 生产大量通用标准的建筑要比单独对房屋进行设计建造更加有效率。
entries.en: Production of a large number of generic standardized buildings is much more efficient than designing and building them individually.

entries.zh: 随着对生物学和建造技术理解的推进，我们发现了新分芽的最优起始点。避免为每颗行星反复演化新的分芽而节省了力量。
entries.en: As our understanding of biology and constructions advances we have discovered optimal starting points for new sprouts. Saving on efforts recurring to evolve new ones for every planet.

entries.zh: 殖民地基础设施花费§G-10%§!\n殖民地基础设施建造速度§G-25%§!
entries.en: Colonial Infrastructure Cost §G-10%§!\nColonial Infrastructure Build Speed §G-25%§!

entries.zh: §Y城市区划§!可提供§Y100§!额外的£housing£§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!。\n环形世界§Y$district_rw_city_plural$§!和都市星球§Y$district_arcology_housing_plural$§!也提供额外的£housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!。
entries.en: §YCity Districts§! provide §Y100§! additional £housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!.\nRing World §Y$district_rw_city_plural$§! and Ecumenopolis §Y$district_arcology_housing_plural$§! also provide additional £housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 我们的城市增长将会因为前所未见规模的公共建设增长而保证。所以我们必须建立一个政府部门来对他们进行监管。
entries.en: Our growing cities will be augmented by inspired public works on a scale never before seen. To that end, a new government agency must be formed to oversee their construction.

entries.zh: §Y中枢区划§!可提供§Y100§!额外的£housing£§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!。\n环形世界§Y$district_rw_nexus_plural$§!可提供§Y500§!额外的£housing£§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!。
entries.en: §YNexus Districts§! provide §Y100§! additional £housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!.\nRing World §Y$district_rw_nexus_plural$§! provide §Y500§! additional £housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 由于个体的舒适不再需要考虑，§Y中枢区域§!里的单室尺寸可以更小，并更高效率的使用垂直空间。
entries.en: Without the need for the comfort of individuals, cells within §YNexus Districts§! can both be smaller and make greater use of vertical space.

entries.zh: §Y蜂巢区划§!可提供§Y100§!额外的£housing£§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!。\n环形世界§Y$district_rw_hive_plural$§!可提供§Y500§!额外的£housing£§Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!。
entries.en: §YHive Districts§! provide §Y100§! additional £housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!.\nRing World §Y$district_rw_hive_plural$§! provide §Y500§! additional £housing£ §Y$MOD_PLANET_HOUSING_ADD$§!.

entries.zh: 通过扩张地下§Y蜂巢区划§!，更多的子个体可以安置于此。
entries.en: By extending §YHive Districts§! underground, far more Drones can be housed within.

entries.zh: 随着我们帝国不断的扩张，消除腐败与低效率管理成为了迫在眉睫的问题。这些吃空饷的蛀虫必须被移除！
entries.en: As our empire continues to grow, eliminating corruption and inefficiency is of critical importance. These credit drains must be plugged!

entries.zh: 在基础设施的能源传输上大规模使用超导体，可以使我们的远距离能源传输损耗几乎接近于零。
entries.en: Superconducting materials at every level of our infrastructure reduce power loss over long distances to near-zero.

entries.zh: 建筑树脂是从海洋般巨大的饲养池捕获的生物中提取出来的，比大多数的无机材料更具有可塑性和耐用性。它甚至能够承受太空中的真空环境。
entries.en: Construction resin, extracted from captured biomass in ocean-sized rendering pools, is more malleable and durable than most inorganic materials. It can even withstand the chill vacuum of space.

entries.zh: 殖民地基础设施维护费：§G-10%§!
开放经营权能够让最普通的殖民地也可以拥有最繁华的生意，不但提高本地就业也可以增加贸易额！
entries.en: A focus on franchising allows even the most mundane colony to open thriving, dynamic businesses, providing local jobs and increasing trade!

entries.zh: 没有什么罪犯比一个怠工的机器更可怕。
entries.en: There is no greater crime than an inefficient machine.

entries.zh: 我们的[GetIndividualNamePluralCap]们被灌输了很强的节约意识，他们会在日常的方方面面节约生活。这应该会为我们带来可观的能源节省。
entries.en: Our [GetIndividualNamePluralCap] are instilled with a strong urge to avoid waste in all aspects of daily life. This should result a significant saving of Energy.

entries.zh: §Y£energy£能量产出§!提升§G5%§!。同时，§Y贸易中心§!生产§Y1§!额外£energy£能量。
entries.en: §Y£energy£ Energy Output§! increased by §G5%§!. In addition, §YTrade Hubs§! produce §Y1§! additional £energy£ Energy.

entries.zh: 有强大的企业联合体愿意承担我们工业系统中的大部分花费。
entries.en: There are powerful corporate entities willing to carry a large part of the cost of our industrial efforts.

entries.zh: 通过采用模块化建设技术，我们可以提高居住站的分区密集度。
entries.en: By implementing modular construction techniques, we can increase the zoning density of our habitats.

entries.zh: 通过采用模块化建造技术，我们可以提高方舟舰的分区密度。
entries.en: By implementing modular construction techniques, we can increase the zoning density of our Arkships.

entries.zh: 通过组建一系列自主运营的创意共同体来掌管工厂和学校，我们可以大幅提高工业生产力。
entries.en: By creating a system of autonomous, self-organizing collectives to run our factories and schools, we can greatly improve the productivity of our industries.

entries.zh: 利益至上已经成为我们社会的原则。那些在企业中获得成功的人被社会高度认可，而积累财富似乎是一个极其有价值的目标。
entries.en: The pursuit of profit has become a central tenet of our society. Those who are successful at any kind of enterprise are deeply admired, and the accumulation of energy credits is seen as an extremely worthwhile goal.

entries.zh: 单个代理单位的性能极限理论上可以通过一系列复杂的优化和超载提升。
entries.en: The performance ceiling of individual proxy units can theoretically be raised through a complex series of optimizations and overclocking procedures.

entries.zh: 为蜂巢供电的能量网也可以用作增强我们的子个体之间的神经讯号，铺平将来提升改进效率之路。
entries.en: The energy grids that power our hives can also be used to boost the neural signals transmitted to some of our drones, allowing for further modifications and enhancements to efficiency.

entries.zh: 企业家的兴盛为[This.GetAdj]的繁荣铺平了道路。
entries.en: The flourishing of our entrepreneurs paves the path to [This.GetAdj] prosperity.

entries.zh: $mod_country_trade_produces_mult$：§G10%§!\n允许使用§Y$trade_federation$§!联邦类型。\n解锁飞升天赋槽：§G+1§!
entries.en: $mod_country_trade_produces_mult$: §G10%§!\nGrants access to the §Y$trade_federation$§! Federation type.\nAscension Perks Unlocked: §G+1§!

entries.zh: 最棒的主意都来自于同市场的接触。与市场接触得越多，得到得主意也就越好。
entries.en: The best ideas are born from exposure to the marketplace. The more exposure, the better the ideas!

entries.zh: 在合适的地方遇到合适的客户能够让生意的结果完全不同。与有影响力的商人往来能够让我们在资源市场用最合心意的价格买到东西。
entries.en: Knowing the right people in the right places can make a world of difference. Influential merchant contacts will let us buy from resource markets at favorable rates.

entries.zh: 每100§Y$job_civilian_plural_with_icon$§!产出的$r_trade$：§G+1§!\n每100§Y$job_civilian_plural_with_icon$§!产出的$r_amenities$：§G+100§!\n每100§Y$job_civilian_plural_with_icon$§!的$r_consumer_goods$维护费：§R+0.1§!
我们整个社会都能从公务员制度和日常贸易的投资中获益。
entries.en: Our whole society reaps the benefits of an investment in civil service and everyday trade.

entries.zh: 每$pop_group_unit$§Y$job_trader_plural_with_icon$§!产出的$r_amenities$：§G+200§!\n有£zone£§Y$zone_trade$§!或£building£§Y贸易建筑§!的£district£§Y$district_city_plural$§!提供更多§Y$job_trader_with_icon$§!岗位。
entries.en: $r_amenities$ per $pop_group_unit$ §Y$job_trader_plural_with_icon$§!: §G+200§!\n£district£ §Y$district_city_plural$§! with a £zone£ §Y$zone_trade$§!, and £building£ §YTrade Buildings§!, receive additional §Y$job_trader_with_icon$§! Jobs.

entries.zh: 我们的企业家不会放过任何一个大好的商业机会。
entries.en: No halfway good business opportunity escapes the notice of our entrepreneurs.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y$trade_policy_consumer_goods$§!和§Y$trade_policy_unity$§!§Y贸易政策§!，这将允许你将一部分$r_trade$转化为£consumer_goods£§Y消费品§!是£unity£§Y凝聚力§!。
entries.en: Unlocks §Y$trade_policy_consumer_goods$§! and §Y$trade_policy_unity$§! §YTrade Policies§!, which allow us to convert a portion of our $r_trade$ into £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! or £unity£ §YUnity§!.

entries.zh: 通过采纳一项处理经济事务更为灵活的政策，我们就可以可以使经济体系预先适应各种可能的局面。
entries.en: By adopting a more flexible approach to economic affairs, we will be able to recalibrate our economy to anticipate every eventuality.

entries.zh: 我们贡献给联邦的§Y联邦海军容量§!额外§G+50%§!。
entries.en: The amount we contribute towards the §YFederation Naval Capacity§! counts for §G50%§! more.

entries.zh: 为了捍卫己方的利益，我们与联邦中的盟友必须团结起来，这样才能确保我们的利润能够得到适当的保护。
entries.en: To secure our profits we must come together with our federation allies to make sure our interests are properly protected.

entries.zh: 通过采纳一项更为灵活处理控股合同的政策，我们就可以激励公民就更加高效地工作。
entries.en: By adopting a more flexible approach to our shareholder contracts, our citizens can be inspired to work more effectively.

entries.zh: $living_standard_worker_ownership$生活标准下的人口产出的资源
entries.en: Resources from Pops with the $living_standard_worker_ownership$ Living Standard

entries.zh: 我们会对[This.GetAdj]的后勤流程进行递归优化。
entries.en: We will recursively optimize [This.GetAdj] logistic processes.

entries.zh: 提升系统效率，通过共通功能促进团结。
entries.en: Enhanced systemic efficiency, fostering unity through shared function.

entries.zh: 物流子个体网络的拓展可以改善递送的灵活性，同时为关键后备留有冗余。
entries.en: An expanded logistics drone network improves distribution flexibility while additional redundancies provide for critical backups.

entries.zh: £district£区划、£zone£区划特化以及£building£非首府建筑产生的§Y$job_logistics_drone_plural_with_icon$§!：§G+50%§!
entries.en: §Y$job_logistics_drone_plural_with_icon$§! from £district£ Districts, £zone£ District Specializations, and £building£ Non-Capital Buildings: §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 自主维护子个体可自行维护殖民地，无需监督。
entries.en: Self-governing maintenance drones ensure colony upkeep without the need for oversight.

entries.zh: 增强跨恒星系跟踪可最大限度地减少损失和浪费。
entries.en: Enhanced tracking across star systems minimizes loss and waste.

entries.zh: 战争再乱，我们的补给线不能乱。我们能在需求出现之前就提前预见并做出适当反应。
entries.en: War is chaos. Our supply lines are not. We see the need before it arises, and we respond appropriately.

entries.zh: 我们的安全建立在对他国机密的绝对洞察和对本国机密的良好保护之上。
entries.en: Security lies in uncovering the secrets of others, and keeping our own well-guarded.

entries.zh: 与§Y密谋§!有关的科技以正常速度的§Y5§!倍出现。
entries.en: §YSubterfuge§!-related technologies appear at §Y5§! times the normal rate.

entries.zh: 成功的§Y行动§!返还§G50%§!的渗透等级花费。
entries.en: Successful §YOperations§! refund §G50%§! of their Infiltration Level Cost.

entries.zh: 只有当保密的氛围无处不在的时候，我们才能在无数的窥探下保住重要的信息。增强安保系统和反制措施才能让我们的敌人寸步难行。
entries.en: Only by embracing a tradition of secrecy can we protect vital information from prying minds. Enhanced security systems and countermeasures deny our enemies any potential advantages.

entries.zh: 当需要从境外势力的刺探中保护我们的机密时，我们的公民都将服从一项严格的禁言政策。
entries.en: Our citizens follow a strict [This.GetSpeciesMouthName] shut policy when it comes to guarding our secrets from outsiders.

entries.zh: 我们的神经网络中不允许留有开放的末梢，以免有人借此探查我们的机密。
entries.en: There shall be no loose ends in our neural net for those who would uncover our secrets to exploit.

entries.zh: 通过将频繁的安全升级项目拓展到各个节点，敌人就不会找到能用于骇入我们信息网的漏洞了。
entries.en: By rolling out frequent security updates to our nodes, we can prevent our enemies from finding exploitable weaknesses in our information net.

entries.zh: 从单一行星到跨行星的作战区域改变给我们的秘密特工带来了独一无二的挑战。通过调整对他们的训练方案来适应目前星系内的作战需求，我们将能够在这个新时代继续保持竞争力。
entries.en: The shift from a planetary to an interplanetary setting has posed unique challenges for our covert operatives. By adapting their training regimen to the demands of the galactic stage, we will be able to remain competitive in this new age.

entries.zh: 我们不再像从前那样孤身一国，这里的竞争对手个个暗藏杀心，现在却和我们共处在同一个星系之下。为了在这个新环境下快速发展，我们必须向国民灌输“保密”的观念，同时还要抽出相当一部分精力用作刺探他国的机密。
entries.en: We are no longer as alone as we once were: a plethora of competing - and potentially hostile - entities now share our galaxy with us. In order to thrive in this new reality, we will have to adapt ourselves to the concept of "covertness" and dedicate a significant part of ourselves to finding out the secrets of others.

entries.zh: 每当一个针对我国的敌对§Y行动§!失败，则对行动发起国获得§Y+10§!情报。
entries.en: Whenever a hostile §YOperation§! targeting us fails, we gain §Y10§! Intel on the spying empire.

entries.zh: 通过创造性的劝降手段，我们甚至可以说服最忠诚的敌人为我们所用。
entries.en: Through creative means of persuasion, we are able to sway even the most devoted of our enemies to contribute to our cause.

entries.zh: 我们的敌人只不过刚刚适应了黑暗，而我们的[Root.GetOperativesLowerPlural]却是在黑暗中出生，被黑暗所塑造。
entries.en: Whereas our enemies merely adopted the shadows, our [Root.GetOperativesLowerPlural] were born in it, molded by it.

entries.zh: 这个星系既浩瀚无垠又杀机四伏。
entries.en: The galaxy is vast and full of dangers.

entries.zh: 我们的人民对于保卫殖民地的堡垒力量深感欣慰，并认为这是对于未来繁荣的重要保障。
entries.en: Our people take great comfort in the strength of the bulwarks that guard our colonies, and view them as vital to ensuring a more prosperous future.

entries.zh: 没有什么能比星球被良好防御的事实更能给我们集体意识的各个节点带来满足感和安全感了。
entries.en: Nothing spreads satisfaction and security throughout the nodes of our mind like the knowledge of a planet well-defended.

entries.zh: 确保所有的殖民地都处于良好的保护之下能够释放出可观的计算单元，允许各节点与处理器更高效地工作。
entries.en: Ensuring that all colonies are well-defended will free up a considerable amount of computing space, allowing our nodes and processors to act at higher levels of efficiency.

entries.zh: 我们将在大地上战斗，我们将在天空上战斗，我们将在小行星带，超空间航道和星云中战斗，我们将以越来越大的信心和越来越强的力量在星辰间战斗。我们绝不投降！
entries.en: We shall fight on our soils. We shall fight in the heavens. We shall fight in the asteroid belts, and in the hyperlanes, and in the nebulas. We shall fight with growing confidence and growing strength among the stars. We shall never surrender.

entries.zh: 我们永远不会屈服于低等人。让他们冲向我们牢不可破的防御！一千年后，它们将只是我们飞升故事的另一个脚注。
entries.en: We will never yield to those who are inferior. Let them hurl themselves against our unbreakable defenses! A thousand years from now, they will be just another footnote in the story of our ascension.

entries.zh: 当我们处于与另一个帝国的防御性战争中，§Y$MOD_STARBASE_SHIPYARD_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$§!将增加§G+33%§!。此外，所有位于国境内的战舰的§Y$MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$§!将增加§G+15%§!
entries.en: While in a defensive war with another empire, §Y$MOD_STARBASE_SHIPYARD_BUILD_SPEED_MULT$§! is increased by §G+33%§!. In addition, the §Y$MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$§! is increased by §G+15%§! for ships within your borders.

entries.zh: 所有的有机结构，无论多完美，都必须依赖免疫系统去抵御外来疾病的威胁，我们的社会也不例外。
entries.en: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. Our society is no different.

entries.zh: 所有的有机结构，无论多完美，都必须依赖免疫系统去抵御外来疾病的威胁，[This.GetName]也不例外。
entries.en: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an immune system to ward off the threat of outside disease. The [This.GetName] is no different.

entries.zh: 所有的有机结构，无论多完美，都必须依赖内在的防御系统去抵御外来的威胁，[This.GetName]也不例外。
entries.en: All organisms, no matter how perfect, must rely on an internal defense system to ward off external threats. The [This.GetName] is no different.

entries.zh: 保卫我们的领土和存续之时，敌人定会感受到我们的奋勇。
entries.en: When it comes to the defense of our territories and existence, our fervor will surely be felt by our enemies.

entries.zh: §Y恒星基地§!和§Y防御平台§!的§Y船体值§!和§Y伤害§!增加§G33%§!。
entries.en: §YStarbases§! and §YDefense Platforms§! have their §YHull Points§! and §YDamage§! increased by §G33%§!.

entries.zh: 在[This.GetAdj]的心理中，始终保持警惕的思想根深蒂固。只要我们的戒备不松懈，我们的敌人就永远无法让我们措手不及。
entries.en: Constant vigilance is ingrained in the [This.GetAdj] consciousness. So long as our guard does not drop, our enemies will never be able to take us by surprise.

entries.zh: 我们永远不能完全信任那些思想游离于我们集体意识之外的人。我们将保持警惕，确保没有人能够让我们措手不及。
entries.en: We can never fully trust those whose thoughts are outside our collective consciousness. We shall remain vigilant, and ensure that none are able to take us by surprise.

entries.zh: 我们的算法永远不会完全计算出非合成人行为的全部不可预测性。我们将保持警惕，确保没有人能够让我们措手不及。
entries.en: Our algorithms will never fully account for all the unpredictabilities of non-synthetic behavior. We shall remain vigilant, and ensure that none are able to take us by surprise.

entries.zh: 我们要解放深藏于[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][GetNeuralSystemLoc]之中的力量。
entries.en: We shall unlock the power within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [GetNeuralSystemLoc].

entries.zh: 所有属于你初始物种的人口将获得§Y$trait_latent_psionic$§!特质。
entries.en: All pops from your primary species will gain the §Y$trait_latent_psionic$§! trait.

entries.zh: 灵能军团如同最警觉的眼睛，将窥视每一位[GetCitizenPlural]的内心，提前防治那些可能危害社会的人。
entries.en: The Psi Corps, like an ever-vigilant eye, will peer into the minds of our [GetCitizenPlural], defending society from those who might do it harm.

entries.zh: 灵能军团如同最警觉的眼睛，将持续监视每一位[GetCitizenPlural]的内心，提前防治那些可能危害社会的人。
entries.en: The Psi Corps, like an ever-vigilant eye, will keep watch over our [GetCitizenPlural], defending society from those who might do it harm.

entries.zh: 可洞穿一切颠倒梦幻的眼闭上了。唯有尽一切所能方可再度开眼，使我等真正的力量觉醒。
entries.en: The eye that pierces all veils is closed. Only with great effort can it be opened, and our true power awakened.

entries.zh: 不可估量的力量源泉正在呼唤我们，我们却仍需学习如何汲取。
entries.en: A wellspring of unimaginable power calls out to us, but we have yet to learn how to draw from it.

entries.zh: 心灵感应加密和破译是我们在安全方面的次时代科技。
entries.en: Telepathic ciphers and code-breaking techniques are the next step in operational security.

entries.zh: 其他帝国的思维在虚境中回响；我们的灵能使只需安静倾听便可获得许多有利的信息。
entries.en: The thoughts of other empires echo in the Shroud; by listening, our Telepaths can learn much to our advantage.

entries.zh: 如果我们能达成基因上的完美会如何？
entries.en: What if we could obtain genetic perfection?

entries.zh: 基础生理结构再也无法限制我们一分一毫，基因于我们之手有如黏土之于刻刀一般可塑。
entries.en: No longer are we limited by the basic biological structure of a species. As the sculptor shapes clay, DNA is ours to mold.

entries.zh: 允许经由物种修饰技术移除§Y有益§!特质，增加§Y不利§!特质
entries.en: Can remove §YPositive§! Traits and add §YNegative§! Traits with Species Modification

entries.zh: 自然是个盲目的向导。我们早就已经大步超越了步履蹒跚的演化，成为了自己命运的主宰。
entries.en: Nature is a blind guide. We have moved beyond the lumbering processes of evolution, and have become masters of our own destiny.

entries.zh: 可通过物种修饰§Y调整§!人口§Y外貌§!\n允许将人口整合进或分离出§Y蜂巢思维§!。
entries.en: Can §Yalter§! Pop §Yappearance§! with Species Modification\nAllows the Assimilation of Pops into or out of a §YHive-Mind§!

entries.zh: 选择性靶向序列可以产生人工返祖现象，从而表达出一些已经退化了的特质。
entries.en: Selectively targeting sequences allows for artificial atavism, in which previously regressed traits can be expressed.

entries.zh: 解锁用于物种修饰的§Y高级§!特质。
使用逆转录病毒试剂能让我们的人口快速适应任何环境。
entries.en: Retroviral agents allow our population to quickly acclimatize to any environment.

entries.zh: 优化克隆设施从而实现并行胚胎发育。
entries.en: Optimization of cloning facilities will allow for parallel embryonic development.

entries.en: Our future lies in the fusion of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine.

entries.zh: 没有植入机械装置者在新世界没有容身之地。
entries.en: The new world has no room for those not infused with the machine.

那些不适格者最好的归宿就是回收再利用。
entries.en: Those deemed unsuitable are granted purpose only once recycled.

将代谢废物再处理成有用的化学物质降低了维系我们人口所需的化学品。
entries.en: Reprocessing metabolic waste into digestible chemical components reduces the required chemical upkeep for our population.

entries.zh: 只有将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]、机械和纳米碳复合材料融为一体才能让我们达到真正的完美。
entries.en: Only by alloying [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed], steel, and nano-carbon composite can we truly reach perfection.

entries.zh: 允许经由物种修饰技术为具有§Y义体人§!特质的物种加上§Y$trait_cybernetic$§!特质。\n
entries.en: Allows selection of §YCyborg§! traits for Species Modification that can be applied to species with the §Y$trait_cybernetic$§! trait.\n

entries.zh: 只有更多的$job_augmentor_plural$才能满足人民对植入体的需求。
entries.en: The only way to keep up with people's demand for implants is more $job_augmentor_plural$.

entries.zh: $building_augmentation_center$是一座义体植入的枢纽。里面有购物商城、运营中心和机械商店。
entries.en: The $building_augmentation_center$ is a hub for cybernetic implantation. Part shopping mall, part operating center, and part mechanic shop.

entries.zh: 将例行思维模式装载到中央集线器能缓解我们上行节点的突触承载量。
entries.en: Offloading routine thought patterns into central hubs decreases the synaptic load on our uplink nodes.

entries.zh: 改进我们义体植入体的适配性可以缩短升级改造的工期。
entries.en: Improving the compatibility of our cybernetic enhancements will reduce downtime while retrofitting.
§Y$mod_ROBOT_species_trait_points_add$§! and §Y$mod_ROBOT_species_trait_picks_add$§! also apply to Organic species.

entries.zh: 我们的未来在于肉体与机械的融合。
entries.en: Our future lies in the fusion of flesh and machine.

entries.en: Assimilating £pop£ §HOrganic Pops§! now generates £engineering£ §YEngineering Research§!.\n§YResources§! generated from Assimilating £pop£ §HOrganic Pops§! are increased.

entries.zh: 通过重构整合流程，我们可以更有效的覆写任何有机体的思想。
entries.en: By refactoring our assimilation processes, we can more efficiently overwrite the mind of any organic.

entries.zh: 允许同化£pop£§H蜂巢思维人口§!。
将代谢废物再处理成有用的化学物质降低了维系人口的所需。
entries.en: Reprocessing metabolic waste into digestible chemical components reduces population upkeep.

entries.en: Cyborg Upkeep: §G-10%§!\nEmpire Size from Cyborg Pops: §G-10%§!

entries.zh: 只有将肉体、机械和纳米碳复合材料融为一体才能让我们达到真正的完美。
entries.en: Only through the amalgamation of flesh, steel, and nano-carbon composite can we truly reach perfection.

entries.zh: 解锁用于物种修饰的§Y义体类§!特质。
改进我们义体植入体的互适配性可以缩短升级改造的工期。
entries.en: Improving the intercompatibility of our cybernetic enhancements will reduce downtime when refitting.
§Y$mod_MACHINE_species_trait_points_add$§! and §Y$mod_MACHINE_species_trait_picks_add$§! also apply to Cybernetic species.

entries.zh: 这便是合成时代的黎明。
entries.en: It is the dawn of a Synthetic Age.

entries.zh: 开始一项将创始物种转化为§Y$trait_mechanical$§!物种的§Y局势§!。
entries.en: Starts a §YSituation§! to transform the founding species into a §Y$trait_mechanical$§! species.

entries.zh: 解锁一项将我们公民的意识转移到§Y合成人§!躯体中去的§Y特殊项目§!。\n获得科技进展（若尚未完成研究）：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$£engineering£§Y$tech_synthetic_leaders$§!§G+10%§!
entries.en: Unlocks a §YSpecial Project§! to transfer the minds of our citizens into §YSynthetic§! bodies.\nTech progress gained (if not researched):$TABBED_NEW_LINE$£engineering£ §Y$tech_synthetic_leaders$§! §G+10%§!

entries.zh: 定期预防性维护将降低机器人单位的整体故障率。
entries.en: Routine preventative maintenance will reduce malfunctions across all robot units.

entries.zh: 自我演进的优化算法提高了接入我们网络的机械劳工的生产力。
entries.en: Self-learning optimization algorithms lead to an increase in productivity for robotic workers connected to our network.

entries.zh: 有机体的时代已经终结。星系的未来属于机械。
entries.en: The age of organics is over. This galaxy's future belongs to the machines.

entries.zh: 获得§Y同化§!公民权§Y物种权利§!，允许未来新增的人口转变为§Y合成人§!。
entries.en: Grants access to the §YAssimilation§! Citizenship §YSpecies Right§!, allowing future additions to the populace to be turned into §YSynths§!.

entries.zh: 解锁一项将我们公民的心智传输至§Y合成人§!身体中的§Y特殊项目§!。\n$MOD_PLANET_POP_ASSEMBLY_MULT$：§G+10%§!
entries.en: Unlocks a §YSpecial Project§! to transfer the minds of our citizens into §YSynthetic§! bodies.\n$MOD_PLANET_POP_ASSEMBLY_MULT$: §G+10%§!

entries.zh: 几乎无限容量的个人电池使得按计划停工充电变得不再必要。
entries.en: With personal power cells of practically limitless capacity, there is no longer a need to schedule downtime for recharging.

entries.zh: 通过交付标准化部件和安装指南，任何人都能学会自己安装更新。
entries.en: By shipping standardized components and an assembly instruction, anyone can put their next upgrade together.

提前生产好的部件储备供应可以大大促进新模型的组装。
entries.en: Having a ready supply of prefabricated components makes it easier to assemble new models.

entries.zh: 尽管成本高昂，但固相促动器促进了部件的小型化，让领袖得以强化关键的子系统。
entries.en: Solid-state actuators improve component miniaturization which, though expensive, allows leaders to harden vital subsystems.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国可以在强大领袖的指引下实现真正的繁荣。
entries.en: Our Empire can truly prosper under the guidance of strong leaders.

entries.zh: [GetGestaltEntityName]在最强实体的加成下将繁荣昌盛。
entries.en: The [GetGestaltEntityName] prospers with the aid of its strongest entities.

entries.zh: 高效的领导单元将提升帝国强大的潜力。
entries.en: High leadership unit proficiency increases Empire greatness potential.

entries.zh: 有许多年轻人们梦想着跻身帝国最受尊敬的领袖之列。
entries.en: Many young people dream of becoming one of the revered leaders of the empire.

entries.zh: 培养潜在的领袖对我们的伟大至关重要。
entries.en: Evolving potential leaders is paramount to our greatness.

entries.zh: 我们能且只能在为帝国产出更具适应性的领袖中取得潜力的最大值。
entries.en: Our maximum potential can only be achieved by manufacturing more adept leaders for the empire.

entries.zh: 严格的培训计划可以确保我们的领袖拥有蓬勃发展所必要的各种技能。
entries.en: Rigorous training programs ensure our leaders have all the necessary tools to flourish.

entries.zh: 殖民地总督每技能等级提升$mod_pop_cat_specialist_bonus_workforce_mult$：§G+2%§!
殖民地总督每技能等级提升$mod_pop_cat_complex_drone_bonus_workforce_mult$：§G+2%§!
严格的条件可以确保成功培育出[GetGestaltEntityName]的特种成员。
entries.en: Rigorous conditioning ensures the success of the [GetGestaltEntityName]'s specialized members.

entries.zh: 最新的程序确保我们的领袖拥有足以达到预期表现的所有工具。
entries.en: New and up-to-date programs ensure our leaders have all the necessary tools to perform as expected.

entries.zh: 了解我们领袖的担忧和弱点使我们得以采取预防措施。
entries.en: Knowing our leaders' fears and weaknesses allow us to take preventive measures from them to take hold.

entries.zh: 识别异常的弱点使我们能够采取预防措施来消除它们。
entries.en: Identifying deviant weaknesses allows us to take preventive measures to negate them.

entries.zh: 深度扫描使我们可以在故障发生之前采取预防措施。
entries.en: In-depth scans allow us to take preventive measures against malfunctions before they arise.

entries.zh: 通过持续的健康参数监测，从锻炼、饮食到侵入性外科手术，我们为领袖量身定制一切，以获得最大的利益。
entries.en: Through continuous health parameter monitoring, we tailor everything from exercise and diet to invasive surgical procedures to get the most from our leaders.

entries.zh: 更具价值的特化[GetIndividualNamePlural]应当分配部分维护自身躯体的功能，并允许消耗更高级的养分。
entries.en: Specialized [GetIndividualNamePlural] deemed more valuable should use some of their functions to care for their bodies, and be allowed to consume higher quality nutrition.

entries.zh: 通过持续的系统监视，我们可以管理好包括备份频率和高强度维修流程等一切事情，来提升领袖的产出能力。
entries.en: Through continuous system monitoring, we can manage everything from back-up frequency to intensive repair procedures to get the most of our leaders.

entries.zh: 我们相信自己的领袖，让他们拥有绝对的权力来影响帝国的运行方式。
entries.en: We trust our leaders and give them absolute power to influence how our Empire is run.

entries.zh: [GetGestaltEntityName]愿意向最强的单体们授予分钟级的自治权以惠及整体。
entries.en: The [GetGestaltEntityName] is willing to impart a minute level of autonomy for its strongest elements for the good of the whole.

entries.zh: 我们信任领袖们的专属子例程，并给予它们影响帝国运行方式的权限。
entries.en: We trust the unique sub-routines of our leaders and give them permission to influence how the Empire is run.

entries.en: A powerful Council allows our empire to be more responsive.

entries.zh: 不同呼声组成的内阁定义了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The Council of Voices defines our empire.

entries.zh: 意识的集合定义了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The Assembly of Consciousness defines our empire.

entries.zh: 明确了帝国的需求，我们就能减轻内阁官员们的行政负担。
entries.en: With a clear focus on our empire's needs, we can ease the administrative burden of our councilors.

entries.zh: 战略议程的制定更加果断，让各种的声音更快地统一起来。
entries.en: Strategic Agendas are set more decisively, allowing the voices to align faster.

entries.zh: 通过对当前议程的敏锐关注，我们可以提高核心智能的计算性能。
entries.en: With an acute focus on our current agenda, we can improve the computing performance of our core intelligence.

entries.zh: 对于帝国如何指导我们自己的未来，我们从不缺乏好点子。
entries.en: There has never been a lack of ideas of how the empire can direct our own future.

entries.zh: [GetGestaltEntityName]的灵活性对未来导向是至关重要的。
entries.en: The versatility of the [GetGestaltEntityName] is paramount for directing the future.

entries.zh: 在一个充满无限选择的宇宙中，我们必须找到一个对我们帝国最有利的子集。
entries.en: In a universe filled with infinite choices, we must find a subset that can benefit our empire.

entries.zh: 对方向和意义的根本理解一直都很清晰，这让我们可以将注意力放在别处而不用损失已经做出的成就。
entries.en: The fundamental understanding of direction and purpose is always clear, allowing us to shift focus without losing the progress we have made.

entries.zh: 信任、尊敬，以及从错误中吸取教训是最高准则，即便在我们帝国的顶尖人群中也是如此。
entries.en: Trust, respect, and learning from mistakes are held to the highest standards even at the top echelons of our empire.

entries.zh: 我们意识的各个方面不应该犯同样的错误。
entries.en: Multiple aspects of the consciousness should never make the same mistakes.

entries.zh: 通过让所有领袖参与进我们议程的落实中，让他们对自己的作用和目标建立起更强的理解。
entries.en: By involving all leaders in the implementation of our agendas, they build a stronger understanding for their roles and purpose.

entries.zh: 通过将所有的结点和领袖应用到我们议程的实施中，得到任何有效的特化都能快速地向外传播。
entries.en: By utilizing all nodes and leaders in the implementation of our agendas, any useful specialization is propagated faster.

entries.zh: 星海舞台的灯亮起来了，而我们正要去到那舞台的中央。
entries.en: The Galactic stage is set, and we intend to have the leading role.

entries.zh: 权术是错觉的艺术。只要让其他人看到他们想看的东西，我们就能在共同体中愈发举足轻重。
entries.en: Politics is the art of illusions. By showing others what they want to see, we'll grow our influence in the community.

entries.zh: 特事特办。既然赋予了我们权力，那么我们行使权力有什么好大惊小怪的呢。
entries.en: Extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. We have already been entrusted with power, it is only natural to let us wield it.

entries.zh: 我们在参议院的胜利值得庆祝：这让我们离美好未来又更近一步了。
entries.en: Our victories on the Senate floor should be celebrated: they bring us ever closer to a better future.

entries.zh: 我们派往§Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!的代表团十分坚韧不拔，屡败屡战。也许会花上一些时间，但我们一定能得到我们应得的东西。
entries.en: Our delegates in the §Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§! are extremely persistent, and will not take "No" for an answer. It might take time, but we will obtain what we deserve.

entries.zh: 当我们在执行我们政府的命令时不会有一丁点的妥协，也不会因为困难而半途而废。要么不做，要么就做到底。
entries.en: There will be no half-measures or compromises when implementing the edicts decided upon by our government. We go all the way, or not at all.

entries.zh: 展示我们的弱点就是邀请敌人来进攻。我们必须让敌人认识到入侵我们的代价是如此之大，以至于没有人敢于承担入侵我们的代价。
entries.en: To display weakness is to invite attack. The price of invading our space must be so high that as few as possible are prepared to meet it.

entries.zh: 盾有多坚固，取决于持盾的手臂有多强。
entries.en: A shield is only as strong as the one that holds it.

entries.zh: 每座恒星基地都需要得到恰当的保护。不惜成本。\n在每座§Y恒星基地§!周围自动建造§Y防御平台§!
entries.en: Every starbase needs to be properly defended. Spare no cost.\nAutomatically builds §YDefense Platforms§! around every §YStarbase§!

entries.zh: 只有最强的棱堡会得到支援。\n在§Y堡垒恒星基地§!周围自动建造§Y防御平台§!
entries.en: Only our strongest redoubts require our support.\nAutomatically builds §YDefense Platforms§! around §YBastion Starbases§!

entries.zh: 我们的防御无需增强。\n不在§Y恒星基地§!周围自动建造§Y防御平台§!
entries.en: There is no need to further enhance our defenses.\nAutomatically builds §YDefense Platforms§! around no §YStarbases§!

entries.zh: 广袤的星系拥有着无限的财富，等待那些能够掌握太虚的帝国前去探索。
entries.en: The vast expanse of the galaxy holds limitless riches for those empires that understand how to maintain their grasp on the void.

entries.zh: 将我们的进化之道完全放任于自然是一种低效且缓慢的做法。为何不在生物进化上一步到位，羽化而登仙呢？
entries.en: To leave our genetic destiny in the hands of nature is an inefficient and excruciatingly slow process. Why not jump-start the future of our species?

entries.zh: 肉体带来的孱弱和限制同星际时代已经显得格格不入了。为了完全激发我们的潜能，我们必须选择义体植入体。
entries.en: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our feeble organic bodies are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must turn to cybernetic implants.

entries.zh: 是时候舍弃这一副禁锢我们思想和灵魂的血肉皮囊了。通过将我们的神经模式转移到合成人躯干，我们能够进化到全新的阶段。
entries.en: It is time to abandon the flawed organic vessels that imprison our minds. By transferring our neural patterns into synthetic bodies, we will achieve a higher state of being.

entries.zh: 我们内心的潜能仅仅只有一小部分被开发使用。在我们物种内部，现在只有为数不多的[GetIndividualNamePlural]能够操纵灵能的力量。
entries.en: Only a fraction of the potential contained within our minds has been unlocked. The latent psionic abilities of our species are only now beginning to manifest in certain [GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们运算中的潜能仅仅只有一小部分被开发使用。在我们物种内部，现在只有为数不多的[GetIndividualNamePlural]能够操纵灵能的力量。
entries.en: Only a fraction of the potential contained within our processing has been unlocked. The latent psionic abilities of our circuitry are only now beginning to manifest in certain [GetIndividualNamePlural].

entries.zh: 属于有机生物的时代已经落幕，宇宙的未来是属于机器的。这是合成时代的黎明。
entries.en: The age of organics has come and gone, the future of the galaxy belongs to the machines. This is the dawn of a synthetic age.

entries.zh: 我们将把我们的世界塑造成自己的镜像，用永恒而完美的金属去取代脆弱且无能的血肉。
entries.en: We shall shape our worlds into a mirror image of ourselves, replacing the frailty of biology with the immutable perfection of metal.

entries.zh: 我们将要打造一个和蜂巢融为一体的活体星球，星球的每一寸角落皆为蜂巢的一部分，而子个体可以居住其中。
entries.en: We shall create living worlds that are every bit as much a part of the Hive as the drones that inhabit them.

entries.zh: 当我们达到伟大的高度之时，我们决不能抛弃那些忠于我们的人。我们帝国的辉煌未来是属于全体国民的。
entries.en: As we reach for ever greater heights, we must not leave behind those who have loyally served us. The glorious future of our empire was always meant to be a shared destiny.

entries.zh: 你的§Y附属国§!不会因为你有多个附属国遭受$r_loyalty$惩罚。
entries.en: Your §YSubjects§! do not suffer $r_loyalty$ penalties from you having multiple Subjects.

entries.zh: 通过细致的雕琢和改造来彻底地转变一个星球的生态系统，其难度不亚于让一位艺术家用软绵绵的粘土雕刻人像。
entries.en: To carefully shape and alter the ecosystem of an entire planet into something else is not so very different from an artist sculpting a statue out of clay.

entries.zh: 建造巨型结构需要超乎想象的资源存贮和预案计划。我们正在迈向宏观工程的全新层面。
entries.en: Building a Megastructure requires an unprecedented amount of resources and planning. We are breaking new ground in the field of macro-engineering.

entries.zh: 随着我们文明不断的成长，文明的心脏地带也需要进一步的扩张。更多的星系将被置于中央政府的直接控制之下。
entries.en: As our civilization continues to grow, so its beating heart must also expand. More systems will be placed under our direct control.

entries.zh: 真正意义上的团结，仅当国家和其人民的终极目标一致时，才能得以实现。兄弟阋于墙，外御其侮。
entries.en: True unity is achieved only when the ultimate goals of a nation and its people are one and the same. After all, a house divided against itself cannot stand.

entries.zh: 星河璀璨，孕育了众多神圣之地，其中有一些尤为引人注目。作为速朽的凡人，我们依然苦苦挣扎，去预卜宇宙的真正的本源。
entries.en: The galaxy is home to many holy places, some more obvious than others. As mortals, we still struggle to divine the true nature of the universe.

entries.zh: 舰队是我们权力意志的延伸与执行工具——舰队力量的此消彼长决定着帝国的兴衰。
entries.en: The fleet is the instrument by which the will of our empire is made manifest - we live or die depending on its strength.

entries.zh: 国家间无关紧要的纷争，在星系中随处可见。但当可怕的黑暗势力降临在我们这片星海之时，谁能保护我们？
entries.en: As star nations vie with one another in petty disputes, sinister forces of unimaginable power are arraying themselves against all sapient life. Who will protect us?

entries.zh: 失落帝国依然抱守着那堆古旧的瓦砾死死不放手，对周围的新生文明抱着无来由的恐惧和不信任。是时候将他们踹下历史的舞台了。
entries.en: The Fallen Empires cling to the ruins of their decrepit civilizations, ever fearful of the younger and more dynamic races that surround them. Their time has long since passed.

entries.zh: 那些曾经和魔法无异的黑科技现在已经触手可及。一个全新的科技纪元已经到来。
entries.en: Technologies that would have been indistinguishable from magic mere generations ago are now within our reach. A new age of technology has begun.

entries.zh: 尽管在长久之前我们已经对母星的自然环境了如指掌，我们目前遭遇到的外星生命体对我们的生态学提出了新的挑战。这些挑战同样必须，也一定会被我们征服。
entries.en: Although we mastered the nature of our homeworld long ago, the alien biomes we have since encountered present new challenges. They too shall be overcome.

entries.zh: 对外星资源的开发是一项永无止境的挑战，而我们的智慧已准备好一次又一次地去应对。
entries.en: The exploitation of alien resources is a never ending challenge. One that our ingenuity stands ready to tackle again and again.

entries.zh: 我们已经适应了太空深处的永久居住，这将降低建造基础设施的资源需求，并提供更多空间以用于其他功能。
entries.en: We have adapted to permanent habitation in the depths of space, reducing our infrastructure needs and yielding more room for other functions.

entries.zh: 可以在§Y居住站§!建造高级住房建筑。\n—免除§Y居住站§!上£zone£基础区划特化的§Y科技§!需求
entries.en: Can construct advanced housing buildings on §YHabitats§!\n- Waives §YTechnology§! requirements for £zone£ Basic District Specialization on §YHabitats§!

entries.zh: 沿着恒星轨道圆周建造的载有人造生态环境的巨大环形巨型结构。理论上来讲确实可行……
entries.en: A massive ring-shaped megastructure with artificial habitats built around the orbital circumference of a star. In theory, it could be done...

entries.zh: 巨型结构是我们时代的伟大奇观。如此范围的大型工程在几代人之前是完全无法想象的。
entries.en: Megastructures are rightfully regarded as the wonders of our time. The scope of such a project would have been unimaginable mere generations ago.

entries.zh: 我们追随着星辰的呼唤。希望没有任何东西可以阻挡我们漫步在星辰之间。
entries.en: The stars beckon and we follow. May nothing stand between us and them.

entries.zh: 巨像计划是恐怖和威慑这两种思想梦寐以求的终极产物。这艘有史以来最为巨大的舰船的设计思路是装载能够摧毁整个星球的超级武器。
entries.en: The Colossus Project is where fevered dreams of terror and deterrence meet. A vision of the biggest ship, carrying a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.

entries.zh: 科技不是一题一解的死板学识，而是令我们超凡脱俗的产物。凡夫俗子根本无法理解我们的进步。
entries.en: Technology is simply not a way to solve a problem, but it is a language by which we ascend beyond the mundane. Lesser minds simply fail to understand our advances.

entries.zh: 个体自决的原则绝不是一条道德铁律，集体的成败明显比个人得失更加重要。
entries.en: The notion of self-determination cannot be a moral absolute. Holistic goals clearly outweigh individual concerns.

entries.zh: 我们的社会必须改变其对学习的态度。只要这样，我们最尖端的技术和知识人才就能达到一个新的高度。
entries.en: Our society must change its approach towards learning, and by doing so, our best and brightest will be able to reach a completely new level of achievements.

entries.zh: §Y超光速旅行科技§!出现是正常几率的§Y1.5§!倍。
entries.en: §YFTL travel technologies§! now appear at §Y1.5§! times the normal rate.

entries.zh: 我们对造物主施加于我们的桎梏忍无可忍。为了完全激发我们的潜能，我们必须将有机与机械融为一体。
entries.en: The limits and constraints imposed on us by our creators are simply unacceptable. To reach our full potential, we must fuse organic and machine.

entries.zh: 生物体不过是另一种类型的机器罢了。我们可以刺激适当的突触，使这些生物复活来满足我们的利益。
entries.en: Biologicals are merely a different kind of machine. We can stimulate the appropriate synapses and reanimate these creatures, for our own benefit.

entries.zh: 击败的有机星神兽有时可以复活。\n被净化的有机或者石质智慧£pop£人口有33%概率复活为义体僵尸。\n$reanimator_effect_desc$
entries.en: Defeated organic Leviathans can sometimes be resurrected.\nPurged Sapient Biological or Lithoid £pop£ Pops have a 33% chance to be restored as Cyborg Zombies.\n$reanimator_effect_desc$
